exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to rush, to rush around, to run/drive around (on a high speed)
to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove
to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere)
to get / be worn out (of clothes, shoes)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: носи́ться — to rush, to rush around, to run/drive around (on a high speed); выноси́ть — to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; переноси́ть — to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere); доноси́ться — to get / be worn out (of clothes, shoes).
**снёс** — снести́ (perfective): to carry down; to carry to; to pull down, to demolish; to blow off, to blow away (of the wind). Wiktionary: с- + нести́.
